title: Wazuh NoiseLens policy
description: A proposed set of suppressions to measure against an exported alerts file, plus the alerts you refuse to hide. This is an analysis contract, not deployable Wazuh XML.

protected_level.description: Alerts at or above this level are protected. If a suppression matches one, the run exits with 1.

protect_rule_ids.description: Rule IDs that must never be hidden, whatever their level.

suppressions.description: Combined with OR. An alert matched by several suppressions is counted once in the overall total.

name.description: A unique label shown in reports.

rule_ids.description: Rule IDs this suppression applies to. A suppression must always name its rules.

equals.description: Dotted field paths mapped to exact scalar values. Every predicate must match. Case and value type count. Regex, wildcards and null are not supported.
